name: fix-kalide-xml-name
body: source: the deck-properties request named the deck configuration file `kalide.xml`; inconsistency: no XML file exists in the project — the deck config file is `kalide.yaml` (deck.ConfigFile, internal/deck/config.go:25; requirements.requirement.deck-config; domain.value.deck-config) and nothing parses XML; resolution: the feature is authored against `kalide.yaml` only, and no XML file or key was introduced.
